cards.text: Jesus has just been taken up into heaven while His apostles watched (Acts 1:9). Now they head back to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, a Sabbath day's journey away. That's close, friend, 'forget the car, we're WALKING' close.

cards.question: Back in Jerusalem, where do the apostles go?

answers.text: An upper room where they're staying
The house of Simon the tanner

cards.text: Here's who's in that room: Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James. Two Jameses in one room, so somebody get these men some NAME TAGS.

cards.question: In the upper room are Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James. How many apostles is that?
With one accord, the apostles in the upper room all continue in ___.

cards.text: And it's not just the eleven in there. The women are praying right alongside them, and they're not the only ones.

cards.question: Besides the women, who else is praying with the apostles?

answers.text: Mary the mother of Jesus and His brothers
Lazarus and his sisters Mary and Martha

cards.text: In those days, Peter stands up among the brothers, a gathering of about a hundred and twenty. And I don't know about you, but when the guy who talks the most stands up, I'm pulling up a CHAIR.

cards.question: Peter is about to speak about the apostle who's missing from the upper room. That missing apostle is Thomas.

cards.text: Peter says the Scripture had to be fulfilled. It's about Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.

cards.question: Peter says the Holy Spirit foretold this about Judas through the mouth of ___.
Peter says Judas was one of their number and shared in their ministry.

cards.text: Then the story pauses Peter's speech for a moment. With the reward for his wickedness, Judas bought a field, and there he fell headlong and burst open.

cards.question: Everyone in Jerusalem hears about what happened to Judas, and in their own language they call his field Akeldama. What does that name mean?

cards.text: Back to Peter. He quotes the book of Psalms, "May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it," and then he adds one more line.

cards.question: The second line Peter quotes from Psalms asks for someone else to take Judas's position.

cards.text: So Peter says they need to choose one of the men who were with them while the Lord Jesus went in and out among them. Not somebody who wandered in last week for the free COOKIES.

cards.question: How far back does Peter say the new man has to have been with them?

answers.text: From John's baptism until Jesus was taken up
From the wedding at Cana until the cross
From the Sermon on the Mount until the tomb

cards.question: Peter says the new man must become a witness with them of Jesus's ___.

cards.text: So they put forward two men: Joseph called Barsabbas, also known as Justus, and Matthias. Three names on one man, so forget a name tag, Joseph needs a BANNER.

cards.question: Two men, one spot. What do they do before anything is decided?

answers.text: They let the two men speak

cards.question: In their prayer, they tell the Lord that He knows everyone's ___.

cards.text: They ask the Lord to show them which of the two He has chosen for the ministry and apostleship that Judas abandoned.

cards.question: To decide between Joseph and Matthias, they take a vote.
They cast lots. Who does the lot fall to?

cards.text: So Matthias is added to the eleven apostles. Friend, I spent years counting dust in the back of a junk drawer, and even I can tell you that makes TWELVE.

findings.problem: The setup says only that Scripture concerns Judas. Nothing in the earlier cards points to David rather than Isaiah or Jeremiah, so this blank asks the baker to guess an unseen name instead of reasoning out its meaning.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: The earlier cards establish how long the candidate must have accompanied Jesus, but they do not connect the new apostle's witness to the resurrection. That requirement does not let the baker distinguish resurrection from miracles or parables except by guessing.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
